title: Avacado dip
preamble:
Ingredients:-
2
ripe avocados
½
red onion, finely chopped
1
tomato, deseeded and finely chopped
Juice
of 1 lime
Few
drops of Tabasco, to taste
Small
handful fresh coriander, chopped, plus extra to garnish
To serve
Mustard
biscuits

ripe avocados

handful fresh coriander, chopped, plus extra to garnish

Mustard
biscuits

Method:-
Halve, stone and peel the avocados.
Finely chop the flesh then add to a bowl.
Stir through the onion, tomato, lime juice, Tabasco, coriander and some seasoning.
Spoon mixture on to each chip.
Serve
